sentences.text:
This is an application seeking anticipatory bail filed under Section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023.
2.
The petitioner is accused No.3 in Crime No.42/2024 of Manjeri Police Station.
The offences alleged against the petitioner are punishable under Sections 420, 468, 471 and 406 read with Section 34 IPC.

3. The prosecution case, as narrated in Annexure A7 order, reads thus:-
" Accused Nos.1 and 2, who are the husband and wife, with their common intention to deceive the defacto complainant's bank, availed a loan of Rs.75,55,798/- from Canara Bank, Valluvambrum Branch, where the defacto complainant was working as the Manager, by mortgaging the property owned by the first accused, on 07.02.2013 and they, on the subsequent occasions enhanced the loan amount repeatedly, and thereafter the accused fabricated a forged title deed in respect of the same property,
and handed over the forged document to a third party for using the same as if it were a genuine one and 2025:KER:94470 facilitated the mortgaging of the property in other banks deceitfully, and thereby deceived the defacto complainant's bank."(sic)
4. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Senior Public Prosecutor.
5.
The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner is a bona fide purchaser, who had no knowledge regarding the mortgage.
6. The learned Senior Public Prosecutor opposed the bail plea of the petitioner.

7. Having regard to the circumstances brought out, the mens rea of the petitioner in the commission Sainaba P.P vs State Of Kerala on 5 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/78295305/
2 of the offence is doubtful.

sentences.text: The petitioner has established a prima facie case.
Therefore, I am of the view that the petitioner is entitled to get the benefits contained in Section 482 of the BNSS.

In the result, the Bail Application is allowed as follows:
(a) The petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Officer on 20.12.2025 between 2.00 P.M. and 3.00 P.M. for interrogation.
In the event of her arrest, she shall be released on bail on her executing bond for Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with two solvent sureties each for 2025:KER:94470 the like sum.
(b) The petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Officer as and when required.
(c) The petitioner shall co-operate with the investigation.
(d) If any of the bail conditions are violated by the petitioner, the jurisdictional court will be at liberty to cancel the bail, in accordance with law.
